source_row.english: Taking life is killing another being Purposely, and without a mistake. Stealing is to take possession of Another's wealth by means of force or stealth. Sexual misconduct, of four types, Engaging in improper kinds of sex. Lying's when the meanings of one's words Are understood, a wrong impression given.

spans.rationale: Established taking-life compound, with verse-initial capitalization preserved. Exclude the copular is.
Secure life member within the taking-life parent. No gcod/Taking member is inferred from the whole idiom.
The established intentionality compound has exact glossary purposely. Preserve its verse-initial capital; do not promote the adjacent ma nor bar mined purposely and without mixture.
Negative particle supplies without in the explicit no-mistake construction; the following article is excluded.
First NOR is the error sense, exactly glossary-attested. It is distinct from wealth later.
First other/another modifier belongs to the killed being. Exclude being; the unrelated mined a bodhisattva gloss is rejected and unchanged.
Exact glossary killing for the verb in the definition; preserve GSAD rather than replacing it with GSOD.
Established compound exactly attested as stealing. The constituent negation and taking elements are not asserted separately inside the indivisible English lexical item.
Second other/another refers to the owner of the wealth. Exclude the possessive apostrophe and s, whose genitive relation is not a separate word claim.
Second NOR is the wealth sense; complete glossary and local stealing context distinguish it from the first mistake.

Exact source GTHU has glossary force, including an EWTS-warning flag in the glossary object. MTHU in the prose expansion is counterevidence to spelling certainty, but does not justify silently normalizing this attested source form.
Coordinator supplies the alternatives force or stealth; it does not own the English and in the earlier purposeful/no-mistake description.
Whole inflected lexical word owns stealth, supported by the complete jab bu glossary. Agentive final s remains inside the source word; no separable -s mapping is invented.
Established ownership expression has exact glossary possession. Flat shape keeps the following action verb separate.
The action verb is recast as take in take possession; take is directly glossary-attested for byed and the ownership complement supplies possession separately. Exclude to and the object relation of.

The complete negative eligibility expression is paraphrased as improper in the sexual-conduct definition. Preserve the whole phrase; neither a bgrod/proper mapping nor an unapproved negative-affix split is asserted.

The verbal going/engaging action is rendered Engaging here, as the prose expansion at351 confirms. The curated living being noun sense is inapplicable to this verb and is not promoted into the alignment.
Established sexual-misconduct compound, excluding the following punctuation and of four types. No arbitrary internal sexual/misconduct members are added.
Exact glossary types, describing the four forms of misconduct.
Exact number four in the verse definition, distinct from the following-heading Four in347.
Established lying compound owns Lying, excluding the contracted copula apostrophe-s.
Exact glossary impression; the deceptive change is distributed across wrong and given, which remain unbanked.
Word noun owns words inside the source tshig don compound, kept flat. The attested whole-compound rendering includes an English possessive; the narrow split avoids absorbing supplied one's.
Meaning noun owns meanings, separate from words; the connective of one's remains outside.
Exact glossary understood; the passive auxiliary Are and the intensifying mngon par are not assigned arbitrary separate exponents.

omissions.tib: gcod pa as a member; both ni; du after bsams bzhin; bar after nor; terminal bound o forms
omissions.reason: Taking life is an established whole; taking alone does not preserve cutting/killing content. Topic, adverbial and declarative grammar is distributed across the English predicates. Leave these uncertain independent exponents unbanked without asserting nulls.

omissions.tib: ma/byin/len pa inside ma byin len pa; gyi; agentive s inside jab bus
omissions.reason: Stealing lexicalizes taking what is not given and has no separately secure negative/member split. The owner genitive is expressed by the English possessive construction, and the instrumental relation by shared by means of. Do not manufacture a fifth subword convention or split Tibetan agentive s.

The complete desire entry has desire/wish/intention, while the verse renders the sexual act through kinds of sex. The prose expansion351 distributes desire and engagement across the same paraphrase. A standalone desire/sex or instrumental yis/in mapping is uncertain, so omit it without a false absence null.

omissions.tib: gzhan before sgyur ba; sgyur ba; bound genitive; mngon par
omissions.reason: Changing the impression into another is recast as a wrong impression given. Wrong and given are not individually secured by the other/change records; preserve impression but omit these distributed claims. MNGON PAR adds manifest recognition without a separate explicit modifier; it does not mean the passive auxiliary Are.

omissions.english: is; being; and; a; is to; possessive 's; of; by means of; in; kinds of sex; of; contracted 's when the; of one's; Are; a wrong; given
omissions.reason: Articles, copulas, relation frames and explanatory/idiomatic words stay outside the stated lexical claims. Mid-sentence capitals reflect the eight verse lines; none is corrected or filed as new formatting errata.
